notes: Confirmed measured primary transactions only; explicit retries and late view recoveries separate. No warmup/deployments.
intervalDefinition: Canonical containing-block timestamps for transaction tables. Client timestamps for view/decrypt, which has no inclusion block.
targetDefinition: Transaction-weighted mean of 100*2*containing block gasUsed/block gasLimit; not transaction gas or submitted gasLimit utilization.

reconciliations.timingUse: Supplementary canonical identity/gas only; first-observed timing retained and excluded from canonical latency statistics.
